content.english: You are holy—my multitudes adulate You.
‘Irin and qaddishin and shin’anim speak of Your wondrous deeds,
content.comments: ‘Irin and qaddishin and shin’anim. Types of angels.

content.english: And the stars of light, and the whole host of heaven—
And heaven acknowledges Your wondrous deeds, Adonai! (Psalms 89:6)
The ofannim hasten [with] praise and acknowledgment,
They yearn to see His splendor, and are robed in dread;
Sometimes they speak, and sometimes they are silent—
Indeed, Your faith is in the community of the holy. (Psalms 89:6, continued)

content.transliteration: Rabbu ma‘asav, behats-tsivo veḥochma kol gevulim,
content.english: Great were His deeds when he set all limits [of the world] with wisdom;
He created fire and ice, according to the laws of heaven,
And all labors, and their derivatives, are issue from Him.

content.hebrew: כִּי מִי בַשַּֽׁחַק יַעֲרֹךְ לַיוי, יִדְמֶה לַיוי בִּבְנֵי אֵלִים.
content.transliteration: Ki mi vash-shaḥaḳ ya‘arokh ladonai, yidmé ladonai bivne elim.
content.english: For who in heaven could equal Adonai, could resemble Adonai among the sons of gods? (Psalms 89:7)
His name alone is exalted; [He] is prominent among myriads.
All His works acknowledge Him, with great love.

content.hebrew: כִּי בְחוֹתָם הִכְלִילָם, בְּאֵין יֹצֵא וְאֵין בָּא,
content.transliteration: Ki veḥotam hichlilam, be’en yotsé ve’en ba,
content.english: For He encompassed them all within a seal, with none leaving or entering;
God, declared formidable by the great council of the holy. (Psalms 89:8)
Blessed and declared blessed by His fiery angels,
He is hidden from the eyes of all, but found by those who love Him.
He is a stronghold for the poor, and a refuge for those He loves—
And awesome over all that surround Him. (Psalms 89:8, continued)
You have been wondrous, God, with Your outstretched arm,
When You did awesome deeds, with great resourcefulness.

content.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּל תְּהִלּוֹת מְהַלְּלִים לְךָ דֻמִיָּה:
content.transliteration: Lachen kol tehillot mehalelim lecha dumiyya:
content.english: Therefore, all praises offered befit You:

content.hebrew: יוי אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת מִי כָמוֹךָ חֲסִין יָהּ.
content.transliteration: Adonai elohe tseva’ot, mi chamocha ḥasin yah.
content.english: Adonai, God of Hosts, who is like You, O mighty One, Yah? (Psalms 89:9)
Yah, who can imitate Your deeds and Your mighty acts?
Who can create, without Your existence?
Who can unmake, unless Your works were non-existent?
And Your faith surrounds You.
Surrounding You is dread, from the splendor of Your kingdom.
Your throne is for all generations, and Your enthronement is forever.
All are Your creations, and Your dominion is over all—

content.hebrew: אֵין קָדוֹשׁ כַּיוי כִּי אֵין בִּלְתֶּֽךָ.
content.transliteration: En ḳadosh kadonai ki en biltecha.
content.english: There is none holy like Adonai, for there is none but You. (1 Sam. 2:2)

content.hebrew: אֵֽין־קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיו֖י כִּ֣י אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
content.transliteration: En ḳadosh kadonai ki en biltecha ve’en tsur kelohenu.
content.english: There is none holy like Adonai, for there is none but You; and there is no rock like our God. (1 Sam. 2:2)
And You are holy, enthroned on Israel’s praises. (Ps. 22:4)
